prompt: On a fresh `FaultDisk`, one `Append` of 5 bytes is hit by the first fault listed. Predict each outcome.

trace.label: bytes stored: Short fault with KeepAll
bytes stored: Crash fault with KeepHalf
an Append after the Crash, before Restart

explain: `Lost` stores nothing. `Short` never stores everything: even with KeepAll it keeps one byte fewer than asked. `Crash` stores the kept part, then the disk is dead until `Restart`, so later appends return `ErrCrash`.
